ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with a low global contrast ratio; high-intensity (white) pixels occupy approximately 5-8% of the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white focal spots are distributed stochastically. Distinct white pixel cluster at the distal tips of both lobes. A prominent, larger high-intensity blob is situated on the inner-mid section of the left lobe (viewer's perspective).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees and a depth-to-width bounding box ratio of 1:2.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary. Pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5-15 pixels, with higher irregularity observed on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outer lobe curves. The right lobe exhibits a more vertical sweep trajectory (approx. 70 degrees from horizontal) compared to the left lobe due to whale orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups localized at the distal tips and along the serrated trailing edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, low-density white linear pixel disruptions visible on the medial surface of the right lobe, oriented vertically.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible healed scarring and depigmentation at both lobe tips; structural irregularity at the apex of the right lobe suggestive of past trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly localized, high-intensity white mark resembling a 'mottle' or 'splash' located in the center-left lobe quadrant.
